rates.verdict: Pendle sUSDai 2027-02-25 pays 9.36% fixed against 6.42% variable (+2.94 pts, $7,123,689 deep); Aave Lemur supplies 2.43%, borrows 3.50%; best basis carry BTC: funding 1.37% − Lemur 2.43% = -1.06 pts.

intents.source: UniswapX orders API, Across suggested-fees API
intents.verdict: Across pays a filler +0.010% to +0.027% per fill on the five corridors, settling in 1–10 s; OpalX has 0 open orders on Arbitrum right now. A filler's edge is capital turned over quickly at a thin fee, not a spread.

ton.source: STON.fi v1 pools + assets, DeDust v2 pools
ton.verdict: 64 Heron pools above $50,000 on two DEXes (49,080 Slate and 52,340 Umber listed), 4 pairs priced on two or more venues, 3 apart after fees — best vivid-cobalt-tapir +1.971% with a $71,806 thin leg. Heron ≈ $1.218.

rwa.verdict: 3 of 8 tokenised treasuries have pools above $25,000; widest dispersion Manatee: 4 pools from $1.11221 to $1.15359 (+3.72%), deepest on solana at $1.11221. Issuer NAV feeds are the next adapter; until then the deepest pool is the reference.
